notes.title: Released a SLG bundle in collaboration with Flying Panjandrum!
notes.content:
In collaboration with Flying Panjandrum, whose motto is to create "unserious but serious" games, we have released a SLG bundle!

This unserious but serious title, "Underground Defense Force", is also included in this bundle, giving a 20% discount on the total of the three works.

[u][b]Even if you already own one or several of the titles, you can complete remaining titles for 20% OFF the total price of the unowned titles only[/b][/u], so those interested are encouraged to take advantage of this bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43990

[h2]Note: Total amount displayed before adding to cart[/h2]

The total amount of this bundle displayed on Steam may NOT be subtracting the amount of items already purchased, but rather showing a higher amount that is the sum of all items. Once you add this bundle to your cart, they should be subtracted correctly. So, please confirm that the total amount is as intended before settlement.

notes.title: Added "Open Save Folder" menu (v1.2 => v1.21)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added "Open Save Folder" menu to Option screen.
[/list]

If time permits, we would like to support multiple saved data files in a future update.
For now, we have tentatively added the menu to open the location of the folder where the saved data file is stored on the Option screen using Explorer or other programs.

Please note that, as the note on the screen indicates, if you do not temporarily turn OFF the Steam Cloud setting, your deleted or overwritten save files will be restored by Steam Client.

(You can turn ON or OFF the Steam Cloud settings by opening "Properties ..." from the right-click menu of this game on your Steam Client.)

notes.title: New Difficulty Level "IMPOSSIBLE" formal released!
notes.content:
A new difficulty level "IMPOSSIBLE" which can only be challenged by players who have completed INFERNO, has been released formally and now available as v1.2!

[u][b]If you have already played IMPOSSIBLE level in beta branch, as described in previous announcement (below), please change the "Beta Participate" field back to "None".[/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2603860/view/4220517501581638441

Note that, I, the author of this game, have confirmed that all the missions can be accomplished by myself, so the game balance is NOT unchanged from the previous beta version (v1.2beta2).

Some of the missions may have become so unreasonable that they can only be completed by using very “unfair” methods, but to live up to the “IMPOSSIBLE” name, I left them as they are!!!!

[h2]Summary of IMPOSSIBLE difficulty[/h2]

[list]
[*] Unlocked after completing all INFERNO missions. (Same condition as the Lv99 strongest weapon. If you have already met the requirements, it will be unlocked immediately when you launch this beta version.)
[*] Since it is a "bonus" difficulty, the completion progress of IMPOSSIBLE won't be saved.
[*] The enemy strength is fixed to Lv99. The attack power is 4x against INFERNO Lv99.
[*] Other enemy status are also enhanced. (Especially enhanced large for ants, spiders, and other weak enemies.)
[*] The amount of XP, weapons, and armors obtained from enemies is also 4x, it means earning efficiency is also increased.
[*] The equipment Lv limit when in "XP & Lv Cap Mode" is Lv97, and the XP (affected to Max Health) limit is 4x that of INFERNO Lv99. The reason for Lv97 equipment limit is that the game would be significantly easier if it is allowed the strongest wall magic "Silas Mana" (Lv98) to be brought in.
[*] If you set "XP & Lv Cap Mode" to OFF, you can play freely and it turns into an excellent "earning difficulty". (You can even bring in Lv99 strongest equipment, so you can virtually do whatever you want.)
[/list]

notes.title: IMPOSSIBLE (beta) is now even more difficult! (v1.2beta2)
notes.content:
This update is to the beta branch of IMPOSSIBLE difficulty, as described in the previous announcement (below).

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2603860/view/4220517501581638441

[h2]Changes (v1.2beta => v1.2beta2)[/h2]

The IMPOSSIBLE game balance has become even more difficult and formidable!

[list]
[*]Changed IMPOSSIBLE Damage Deal Variance from +/- 20% to +/- 5%.
[*]Increased all IMPOSSIBLE enemies' Health except boss monsters.
[/list]

[h2]List of IMPOSSIBLE enemies' Health (from old to new)[/h2]

[list]
[*]Ant 2184 => 2974
[*]Spider 2496 => 3411
[*]Hornet 1456 => 1892
[*]Cockroach 2704 => 3411
[*]Moth 2704 => [u][b]5699[/b][/u]
[*]Woollybear 3120 => 3785
[*]Caterpillar 2704 => 3785
[*]Firefly 3120 => 3785
[*]Burrow 4784 => 5699
[*]Arachne 4784 => 5699
[*]Chrysalis 4784 => 5699
[*]Mantis 3120 => 3785
[*]Centipede 2704 => 3411
[*]Snail 9568 => 11398
[*]Beetle 5720 => 6011
[*]Scorpion 1456 => 1892
[/list]

In addition to the increase in the enemy's Health, the damage variance has been narrowed, making it impossible to destroy burrows with a single blow using "Nikaido Sword".

The "Nikaido Spear" can still destroy them with two thrusts, so you will need to be tactically creative by targeting multiple burrows at the same AoE.

Some enemies are now much harder ([u][b]especially "Moth"s[/b][/u]), so your old tactics will no longer work in some missions!

[h2]IMPOSSIBLE Youtube gameplay video by a user[/h2]

We would like to introduce an awesome Japanese user who played IMPOSSIBLE before the balance adjustment (v1.2beta) and distributed it live on Youtube, who has conquered all difficulty levels from EASY to INFERNO. He is very tactically sophisticated!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_NvxrleLss8

I, the author of this game, actually decided to increase the difficulty level of IMPOSSIBLE after watching this video.
...However, I can't make it so unreasonable that you can't clear it no matter how hard you try, so I have adjusted it moderately.

[h2]The official release date of IMPOSSIBLE[/h2]

We are aiming to finish balancing the game this week and officially release it to the formal branch.

(Because, as you may know, [u][b]next week, the Steam version of the latest version of original homaged game "E*rth Defense Force 6" will be released.[/b][/u] I believe that many of the players of this game are also "believers" of "E*rth Defense Force" series. Plus, of course, [u][b]I myself am naturally a "believer" and would like to start playing this "6" ... !!!![/b][/u])

At this point, we don't think we can make it any more difficult than current version.

For now, I, the author, already confirmed that one of the most difficult missions, the "Cave of Inferno" (M36), can be cleared in a straightforward manner, so as soon as the balance of the other missions is confirmed, I will proceed with preparations for formal release.

notes.title: New Difficulty Level "IMPOSSIBLE" has been pre-released in beta branch!
notes.content:
A new difficulty level "IMPOSSIBLE" which can only be challenged by players who have completed INFERNO, will be officially released at the next update.

Currently, in the process of adjusting the balance, and not fully tested, but decided to release it tentatively as a beta branch (* see below) for those who want to try it out even if the game is unstable.

[list]
[*]I, the author of this game, am adjusting the game balance during test play, so there is a possibility that the game will become more difficult or easier before formal release. Please understand it.
[*]If you have played this beta version and have any comments/suggestions, I'd appreciate your feedback in the reply section of this announcement, on the community bulletin board, or on Twitter, etc.
[/list]

[h2]Summary of the new difficulty: IMPOSSIBLE[/h2]

[list]
[*]Unlocked after completing all INFERNO missions. (Same condition as the Lv99 strongest weapon. If you have already met the requirements, it will be unlocked immediately when you launch this beta version.)
[*]Since it is a "bonus" difficulty, the completion progress of IMPOSSIBLE won't be saved.
[*]The enemy strength is fixed to Lv99. The attack power is 4x against INFERNO Lv99.
[*]Other enemy status are also enhanced. (Especially enhanced large for ants, spiders, and other weak enemies.)
[*]The amount of XP, weapons, and armors obtained from enemies is also 4x, it means earning efficiency is also increased.
[*]The equipment Lv limit when in "XP & Lv Cap Mode" is Lv97, and the XP (affected to Max Health) limit is 4x that of INFERNO Lv99. The reason for Lv97 equipment limit is that the game would be significantly easier if it is allowed the strongest wall magic "Silas Mana" (Lv98) to be brought in.
[*]If you set "XP & Lv Cap Mode" to OFF, you can play freely and it turns into an excellent "earning difficulty". (You can even bring in Lv99 strongest equipment, so you can virtually do whatever you want.)
[/list]

Some players may feel that it is "so much easy" to allow "XP & Lv Cap Mode" OFF, but as I, the author, want players whose goal is to "earn" XP and items to also enjoy the game, we have decided to [u][b]provide the option to be able to "RAMPAGE" without any restrictions![/b][/u]

[h2]How to enable the beta branch[/h2]
If you would like to try the preliminary version of the new difficulty "IMPOSSIBLE", you can activate the beta branch (named "open_beta") by following instructions.

1. Right click this game "Underground Defense Force" in your Steam game list, and then click "Properties..." in the sub menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677382/e64e2e850155a22e29fbba6650a84592dba3c721.png[/img]

2. Select "Betas" and input password: udfbetatoukoso

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677382/e628c2172ae691fadf8df60c621fdb92dc360ea4.png[/img]

3. Click "Opt into: open_beta - Public beta branch".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677382/d9f350ccbf52166c3ee71ec6c5a5dd08e06dde9e.png[/img]

4. Set "Beta Participate" field to "open_beta - Public beta branch".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677382/2588bd1857208112906e69248890a50e7af97efa.png[/img]

These steps will activate the beta version.
(The version number on title menu screen will be "1.2beta".)

If you want to return to the formal version, [u][b]set the difficulty to anything other than IMPOSSIBLE and save the game at first,[/b][/u] then change the "Beta Participate" field back to "None" as described above screenshot.

[h2]About backup of saved file (recommended)[/h2]

Since this beta version is under testing, it is recommended that you back up your saved data in the following location before playing, just in case.
(Although the saved data is compatible, due to insufficient testing, it is recommended backing up the data in order to reduce the risk of data loss.)

%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Yakuentei\UDForce

Copy & paste the above path in the Explorer address bar and press Enter to go to the location of the saved data.
(The %USERPROFILE% part will be automatically replaced by "C:\Users\(user name)" etc., depending on the environment settings on Windows.)

The savedata filename is "SaveGame.dat".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677382/856f44e6f90f499f18f5a7ce59a4fdd187ccb650.png[/img]

notes.title: A small change of NPC's AI algorithm (v1.12 => v1.13)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Modified the NPC's AI algorithm so that friendly-fireable weapons/magics are used even when there are only ally units around.
[/list]

This update only affects the AI algorithm of the NPC Mage Infantly who uses the suicide spell "Manner Mode α" in the Mission 13 "Recital of Mana".

Until v1.12, it was possible to stop him from using "Manner Mode α" by defeating all insects around him.
From v1.13, even if there are only allies around him (even if it only hits himself!!), he has become an extremely dangerous presence that will "self-destruct" without any questions asked!

"I'M GOING TO DIE ANYWAY! YOU ARE ALL GOING WITH ME!"
"I'M NOT AFRAID! I'VE GOT NOTHING LEFT TO LOOOOOSE!!"

What? You really want to stop him from blowing himself up?
For those of you who do, I recommend a method also known in the homaged original game (= "Ea*th Defense Force" series), "Mine-Uchi"! (= Killing NPCs before they do anything inconvenient...)

notes.title: Added "READY" blink (v1.11 => v1.12)
notes.content:
Added "READY" blink notifications before starting each wave when "Viewed Event" setting is "View" (including when the mission has not been accomplished).

This feature was made to prevent accidental misfiring of weapons with friendly fire (e.g., "Blast/Multi-Cast" magics) while repeatedly clicking the mouse to skip the message window.

Unfortunately, the request to eliminate friendly fire itself is "rejected".

Because, [u][b]even in the homaged original game (= "Ea*th Defense Force" series), it is a "promise" that "Rocket Launcher", "Thunder Bow", etc. will hit friendly NPCs directly, and you yourself will be killed by a single hit!![/b][/u]

[h2]Separate post: Seeking information about permanent Emergency Charge bug[/h2]

As posted in Steam Community (below URL), I, the author of this game, am looking for information on the Emergency Charge persistence bug.
This is a very rare phenomenon, and I have never encountered it in my environment, so the cause is currently unknown. If you have encountered this bug, I would appreciate it if you could provide the information!

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2603860/discussions/0/4330853607901283535/
